ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area with approximately 20-25% coverage of high-intensity (white) pixels distributed in small clusters and solid distal patches.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-density distribution of small, contiguous white circular rings and dots across both lobes; high-intensity solid white zones mapped to the extreme distal tips of the fluke.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: U-shaped median notch with a calculated angle of approximately 45 degrees at the convergence of the lobe trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (pixel peaks and valleys) observed along the continuous boundary of both trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the leading edges with a shallow concave sweep along the trailing edges directed toward the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial detection of circular high-contrast white pixel clusters across the entire visible ventral surface, consistent with rosette-type scarring.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pervasive circular scarring across both lobes and heavy high-intensity pixel encrustation at the distal lobe tips.
